purpose: Frozen reference environment and measurement protocol for performance budgets. Approved at R0; budgets in the acceptance manual become required gates only against this manifest.

referenceHardware.macOS: Apple Silicon arm64 (reference: Mac mini M2), 16 GB RAM minimum
referenceHardware.windows: x86_64, 16 GB RAM minimum (reference profile: Windows 11 x64)
referenceHardware.linux: x86_64, 16 GB RAM minimum (reference profile: Ubuntu 22.04 x64)

referenceSoftware.os: macOS 26.x / Windows 11 / Ubuntu 22.04 (only the platform under test)
referenceSoftware.webView: WKWebView (macOS) / WebView2 (Windows) / WebKitGTK 4.1 (Linux), stock system build
referenceSoftware.buildProfile: tauri release build (npm run tauri build -- --debug false)

measurementStart: first editable state after document load
measurementEnd: confirmed patch ack and confirmed projection applied
warmUp: 3 warm-up iterations before any sample is recorded
repetitions: >= 3 independent runs per fixture; report median and p95 across runs
noisePolicy: a scenario fails the budget if p95 exceeds the budget in any single run; outliers caused by OS background activity are recorded with the trace, not silently dropped
evidenceMustInclude: raw per-sample traces and environment manifest; averages alone are not accepted (acceptance manual §8.5)
